directAnswer: To determine what your USB-C port supports, check your device's specifications or use a USB-C compatibility checker tool.
summary: Understanding the capabilities of your USB-C port is essential for optimal device performance and compatibility.

sections.heading: Check Device Specifications
sections.body: Most manufacturers list the specifications of USB-C ports in the user manual or on their website. Look for details on power delivery (PD), data transfer rates, and video output capabilities.

sections.heading: Use a USB-C Compatibility Checker
sections.body: There are online tools available that can help you check the compatibility of your USB-C port with various devices and accessories. Input your device model to get detailed information.

steps.title: Identify Your Device Model
steps.detail: Locate the model number of your device, usually found on the back or in the settings menu.

steps.title: Visit Manufacturer's Website
steps.detail: Go to the support section of your device's manufacturer website and search for your model to find detailed specifications.

steps.title: Use a USB-C Compatibility Checker Tool
steps.detail: Search for a USB-C compatibility checker online, input your device model, and review the results for supported features.

faqs.question: Can I charge my laptop with a USB-C phone charger?
faqs.answer: It depends on the power output of the charger and the laptop's requirements. Ensure the charger supports the required wattage.

faqs.question: What is the difference between USB-C and USB 3.0?
faqs.answer: USB-C is a connector type, while USB 3.0 refers to a data transfer standard. USB-C can support USB 3.0, but not all USB-C ports are USB 3.0 compatible.

faqs.question: Are all USB-C cables the same?
faqs.answer: No, USB-C cables can vary in their capabilities, including data transfer speed and power delivery. Always check the specifications of the cable.

caveats: Some devices may have USB-C ports that support only basic charging and data transfer, lacking advanced features like video output.
